title: 🔬 Multiple Science & Research Jobs in Albemarle County, VA - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Charlottesville’s research scene is buzzing, especially at the University of Virginia . If you’re into lab work or postdoctoral research, there are several full-time openings worth a look.
Lab Specialist Intermediate Employer: University of Virginia
Location: Charlottesville, VA
Salary: $50,949–$57,318
Type: Full-time
Join UVA’s Department of Ophthalmology to help manage lab operations and animal research protocols. This role blends hands-on lab work with team leadership and compliance oversight.
Post Doc Research Associate Employer: University of Virginia
Location: Charlottesville, VA
Type: Full-time
Work in Dr. Timothy Bullock’s lab on interdisciplinary research projects. Ideal for recent Ph.D. grads looking to publish, mentor, and grow in a collaborative academic setting.
Postdoctoral Research Associate – Gioeli Lab, Urology Employer: University of Virginia
Location: Charlottesville, VA
Type: Full-time
Dive into cancer biology research focused on prostate cancer progression and therapy resistance. This position offers strong mentorship and opportunities for publication and career development.
If you’re ready to take your science career to the next level, check out these UVA roles and apply soon!
